UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores profile settings and maps a user ID to a registered athlete name.

athleteName.description: The athletic display name in the challenge.

joinedGroups.description: Map of group IDs the user has joined to their group names.

GroupChallenge.title: Group Challenge
GroupChallenge.description: Represents a challenge group created by a user with customized details and rules.

GroupMember.title: Group Member
GroupMember.description: Represents a participant mapping inside a challenge group.

WorkoutActivity.title: Workout Activity
WorkoutActivity.description: Represents an individual workout or run logged by an athlete inside a group.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD local date of the workout.

checkInCode.description: Gym check-in verification code if applicable.

isGymWorkout.description: True if the activity is a strength workout.

userId.description: UID of the user who logged the activity.

ChallengeGoal.title: Challenge Goal
ChallengeGoal.description: Participant's personal monthly targets within a challenge group.

users/{userId}.description: Individual user registrations and challenge profile.

groups/{groupId}.description: Challenge groups created by various users with custom rules.

groups/{groupId}/members/{userId}.description: Roster of participants under a specific challenge group.

groups/{groupId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Workouts list logged dynamically by users inside a specific group.

groups/{groupId}/challenges/{challengeId.description: Athlete monthly targets inside a specific, customized group.
